title: Task params for oedis.handler.archive.extract
description: Configuration for extracting archive files from the inbox with the archive handler.

credential.description: Optional task-level archive credentials. The passphrase is used when a file entry does not provide its own passphrase.

passphrase.description: Optional passphrase used for encrypted zip or 7z input archives.

requests.description: List of archive extraction instructions. Each item describes which archive files to match and where extracted files should be placed.

src_dir.description: Inbox-relative source directory to read from. Empty or omitted means ctx.inbox. Leading / is treated as inbox-rooted shorthand, and the resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox.

include.description: Archive match pattern or list of patterns to include. Examples: '*.zip' or ['*.zip', '*.7z']. When recursive is true, relative paths under src_dir can also match.

exclude.description: Archive match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. When recursive is true, relative paths under src_dir can also match.

format.description: Archive format to extract. Use auto to infer from the matched archive extension; otherwise supported values are zip, tar, gztar, tgz, and 7z.

recursive.description: When true, walk subdirectories under src_dir when matching archive files. When false, only files directly under src_dir are considered.

delete_source_file.description: When true, delete each source archive after it is extracted successfully.

dst_dir.description: Inbox-relative destination directory for extracted files. Empty or omitted keeps the handler's default behavior of extracting beside each source archive. Leading / is treated as inbox-rooted shorthand, and the resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox.

passphrase.description: Optional file-level passphrase. When provided, it overrides credential.passphrase for this archive input.
